name: Bill reader
description: Snap a bill and run this with the photo: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads it (only that assistant sees the photo), you're asked before it's remembered, and it goes into your money memory. Needs NEBIUS_API_KEY.
example: This month's electricity bill (attach the photo).

assistants.name: Bill reader (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL)
assistants.description: Reads photos of bills, receipts and tickets.

steps.ask:
Read the bill in the photo. {{input}}

Say who it's from, what it's for, the amount and the due date, in two short lines. Never repeat an account or card number beyond its last 4 digits. Then a last line of JSON: {"biller": "...", "for": "...", "amount": <number>, "currency": "<ISO code>", "due": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
